description: A 6-SECOND SILENT 1080p PRODUCT CLIP from ONE product photo: the product is first set on a clean seamless background in a colour taken from the product itself (centred, about two thirds of the frame, one soft shadow), then one MOVE is filmed from that frame. Moves by name: label-trace, crane-reveal, floating-roll, detail-scan, half-turn, impact, light-sweep, liquid-wrap, macro-glide, paint-wave, product-spin, pull-back, push-in, shadow-motion, sunrise-pass, texture-track, topdown-dive, whip-pan. Or describe your own move in `describe` (with no `move`); with a named move, `describe` adds to it. Default 3:4; square 1:1, landscape 16:9, Reel/Story 9:16. No people, hands, words or music are added. Two paid steps (the start frame, then the clip); dryRun:true = the price of both, nothing made. For a longer cut-together product film use product_sizzle.

describe.description: a move in your own words, or something to add to a named move

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

move.description: one of the named moves (e.g. 'push-in', 'product-spin'), or omit and use describe

product.description: the product photo: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI

name: product_move
title: Six-second product move
